om_host.title: OpenMetadata Host
om_host.description: Base URL of the OpenMetadata API

options.tooltip: The component appends `/api/v1`. Must be reachable from Keboola's static egress IPs, or via the SSH tunnel below.
In OpenMetadata: Settings → Bots → your bot → Generate new token. A dedicated bot with a long expiry is recommended over the shared ingestion-bot.

use_ssh_tunnel.title: Use SSH Tunnel
use_ssh_tunnel.description: Reach the OpenMetadata host through an SSH bastion

options.tooltip: `rows` catalogs one project per config row (Tier-1). `all_projects` enumerates every organization project and mints short-lived read-only tokens with a management token (Tier-2), degrading to the host project if the token lacks scope. Defaults to config rows.

#manage_token.title: Management Token
#manage_token.description: Management API token with manage:storage-tokens scope

options.tooltip: Org-wide credential used only to enumerate projects and mint short-lived read-only Storage tokens. Host the config in a locked-down admin project.

organization_id.title: Organization ID
organization_id.description: Keboola organization to enumerate (required for All organization projects)

options.tooltip: Required when Project Scope is `all_projects`. Enumeration is bound to this single organization via GET /manage/organizations/{id}/projects; the component never lists all organizations.
One service per stack is recommended. Defaults to a value derived from the stack id when left empty.
Three-way merge leaves fields a human edited in OpenMetadata and logs the divergence. Defaults to three-way merge.
Defaults to collect and fail: per-entity failures are recorded in the run report and the job fails at the end.
Whether to catalog development-branch buckets. Defaults to production only.

write_column_lineage.title: Write Column Lineage (Advanced)
write_column_lineage.description: Emit column-level lineage from transformation SQL

write_pipelines.title: Write Pipelines (Advanced)
write_pipelines.description: Emit Pipeline entities for component configs and flows

write_pipeline_status.title: Write Pipeline Status (Advanced)
write_pipeline_status.description: Emit run history as pipeline status

options.tooltip: Enabled by default when pipelines are written.

full_refresh.title: Full Refresh (Advanced)
full_refresh.description: Ignore per-bucket digests and re-push everything this run

options.tooltip: Disabled by default; incremental digests skip unchanged buckets.
Normally auto-probed via GET /api/v1/system/version. Leave empty.
